body:
SKKU is recruiting 2027 SKKU Global Creators (SGC) program to strengthen the university’s international outreach through student-produced English-language content.

We welcome students who are passionate about content planning and digital media production, as well as those with experience in video shooting, editing, or graphic design.

Eligibility
– Currently enrolled SKKU students (including undergraduate degree-seeking international students)
– Those who earned at least 12 credits and a GPA of 2.0 or higher in the previous semester
– High proficiency in English; knowledge of Korean is helpful but not required

Benefits
– Opportunities for your work to be featured on SKKU’s global platforms as an official SKKU content creator
– Monthly activity incentives (Can not be provided if students fail to meet eligibility requirements during the activity period)
– Certificate of participation upon program completion

Recruitment Timeline
· Application Period: November 6th ~ 22nd
· Interview Date: December 1st ~ 3rd (Afternoon, Zoom interview)
· Results Announcement: December 4th (tentative)
· Orientation & Activity Briefing: December 7th (tentative)
· Activity Period: January 2027 – December 2027

*Scheduled dates are subject to change.
*Interview schedules will be individually notified to applicants who pass the document screening stage.

Application Method

Submit the application through the Google Form link provided.
https://forms.gle/Fw5UbKPHeK9CTagA6

Inquiries
katekim0107@skku.edu
02-760-1149
